claims.assertion: Yazhi describes tulpas as ideas or interpretations that become real through shared perception, and says people and emotions are also idea-forms.
claims.speaker: Yazhi Swaruu

claims.assertion: Yazhi says fear concentrates attention and energy on what is feared, making it rapidly manifest within the fearful person’s perception.
claims.speaker: Yazhi Swaruu

claims.assertion: Yazhi says Earth experiences can carry positive and negative thought-forms back to a person’s homeworld, while rejecting their ideas prevents negative tulpas attaching.
claims.speaker: Yazhi Swaruu

coverage_gaps: Other claims about Source, densities, entities, and negative tulpas omitted
